team_guardrail_note: Roles and the client view are workflow guardrails, not a security boundary: anyone with the snapshot file, or with this computer while the workspace is open, can read the data. Encryption protects the shared folder only.
team_identity_hint: Shown on your notes and used for @mentions.
team_identity_first: Set your name and handle first.
team_mode_none: This install is not part of a team.
team_create_hint: This install keeps the tokens and runs the sync. Teammates get a read-only copy through a synced folder (Dropbox, iCloud Drive, OneDrive or a NAS). No server is involved.
team_join_hint: Pick the synced folder the publisher shares with you. You get a read-only copy of the data; your notes and inbox status sync back.
team_passphrase_optional: Team passphrase (if the team is encrypted)
team_passphrase_hint: Share it with teammates outside the shared folder. It is never written there.
team_keep_copy: Keep a local copy of the shared data
team_leave_confirm: Leave this team? This install goes back to its own data.
team_role_hint: Analysts cannot change setup, secrets, transfers, backups or the publish worker.
team_role_subscriber_hint: A shared workspace is read-only: sync, setup, replies and publishing stay with the publisher.
team_present_hint: Shows only the chosen clients' accounts and client-visible notes, and hides settings, inbox, planner, AI and competitors until the PIN is entered.
team_no_clients: Set client names on accounts first.
team_workspace_banner: Shared workspace, data as of {date} from {publisher}
team_add_note: Add a note… type @ to mention a teammate
